provenance.name: katex
provenance.instrumentation: In-memory VM injection at guarded final-export anchor; archive SHA-256 verified and every inventoried source, contrib, package metadata, bundle, and font file byte-verified against the archive.

colorIsTextColor.description: Makes \color behave like LaTeX's 2-argument \textcolor, instead of LaTeX's one-argument \color mode change.

displayMode.description: Render math in display mode, which puts the math in display style (so \int and \sum are large, for example), and centers the math on the page on its own line.

errorColor.cliDescription: A color string given in the format 'rgb' or 'rrggbb' (no #). This option determines the color of errors rendered by the -t option.

leqno.description: Render display math in leqno style (left-justified tags).

macros.cliDescription: Define custom macro of the form '\foo:expansion' (use multiple -m arguments for multiple macros).

maxExpand.description: Limit the number of macro expansions to the specified number, to prevent e.g. infinite macro loops. If set to Infinity, the macro expander will try to fully expand as in LaTeX.

maxSize.description: If non-zero, all user-specified sizes, e.g. in \rule{500em}{500em}, will be capped to maxSize ems. Otherwise, elements and spaces can be arbitrarily large

minRuleThickness.description: Specifies a minimum thickness, in ems, for fraction lines, `\sqrt` top lines, `{array}` vertical lines, `\hline`, `\hdashline`, `\underline`, `\overline`, and the borders of `\fbox`, `\boxed`, and `\fcolorbox`.

output.description: Determines the markup language of the output.

strict.description: Turn on strict / LaTeX faithfulness mode, which throws an error if the input uses features that are not supported by LaTeX.

throwOnError.cliDescription: Render errors (in the color given by --error-color) instead of throwing a ParseError exception when encountering an error.

trust.description: Trust the input, enabling all HTML features such as \url.

nativeCoverage.note: No per-entry correspondence has been verified against approved requirements; the native name-family evidence is incomplete and counts are not a coverage denominator or percentage.

limitations: Registries capture KaTeX runtime registrations, not arbitrary user macro definitions or all possible inputs.
Function-valued built-in macro bodies are represented by markers; exact implementation semantics are protected by the pinned distribution and hashed source inventory, not serialized function bodies.
Source and contrib listings are package inventories; contrib extensions are not implied core commands.
Font faces are grouped by face stem across TTF/WOFF/WOFF2 files; format variants are not counted as separate faces.
Native feature-family mapping and requirement-level classification remain pending review.
